title: LSI Software — Performance & Growth Systems
description: Full-funnel growth system for a Polish software company: Google Ads restructure, website performance, content architecture, and a growth operating model connecting paid and organic channels.
problem: Ad spend without a clear structure, website without a conversion architecture, and SEO content that didn't connect to any demand signal or buying journey.
system: Growth stack: Google Ads campaign restructure by intent layer, website CRO analysis, content architecture aligned to search demand, and a reporting model that connects channel performance to pipeline.
artifact: Restructured Google Ads account, content brief library, conversion audit, and a growth operating model with clear KPIs across paid and organic.
outcome: Paid spend working within a clear structure; organic content producing compounding traffic; both channels connected to the same pipeline model.
